claims.notes: [BATCH NOTE b091] Scope decisions for this batch. Excluded per instrument rule 5: dates and timestamps (2026-04-10, 2026-04-18, 2026-04-19, 2026-04-20/21, 2026-04-22, 2026-05-03); git commit hashes (`731466d8`, `e07dae37`, `e3aef6fa`, `a9e280a3`, `7f05f529`, `4e5c5e5a..`); session numbers (Session 83); Obs identifiers (Obs 268, 270, 273); the erratum identifier E54; backfill item identifiers (N1-N5, O1, O2, T2) and Tier 1/2/3 labels; hypothesis and run names (h8-v2, h10, h11, h12-v2, `55maps-text-high-generalisation`); numbers inside file paths and condition names (`consensus-384-UNINTENDED-T1.0`, `single-pass-384-UNINTENDED-T1.0`, `pv-diag-384`, `results/h11-384-pv-diagnostic/`, `confusion_matrix_4x4_buf50.csv`, `4326` in map-sheet names); line-number citations (`working-notes.md:12840`, `protocol-errata.md:1695-1697`); the in-quotation section citation "Section 3.5"; and the phase reference Phase 3c. Inclusive decisions (over-inclusion per instrument preamble, doubt recorded on each claim): (a) forward-looking effort estimates (15 min, 5 min, 1-2 h, 30 min, 4-6 h, 8-11 h, ~15-20 h) are extracted as asserted quantities but no artefact can decide them, so they are anchor-unknown; (b) design-descriptor counts ("3-tier repair", "two-stage design", "three-way null", "two-annotator identifiability") are extracted because each asserts a structural fact about the study, but they may be read as names rather than claims; (c) buffer radii for analyses recorded as "Still open" (30/40/50 m) are extracted although no run exists to anchor them. Anchoring note: this is an audit/plan document whose sources are largely other markdown documents, so `anchor-unknown` is common; every such claim names what was searched. Registration/protocol claims follow the v1.1 calibration rule and anchor to the lodged documents under `docs/methodology/preregistration/`. This claim: 160 is the sum of `recovery_history[0].initial_failed` across the five proposer passes and 100 % is recovered/initial_failed over the same five files; per v1.2 amendment 1 the operands are given their own read paths rather than inheriting the arithmetic method.
